text:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — leadership readout prep for the board on Wed 10am PT. Need final slides + three asks by EOD Tue.
Arjun (AM): Got it. I'll consolidate the account health slide and renewal-risk bullets.
Samira (Enablement): I'll own the enablement/training slide and hand off any collateral. ETA Tue noon.
Elliot (Eng): Can someone confirm if the demo link is stable? We had a flake last week.
Olivia (Solutions): Demo env has been patched, but I’ll run a quick smoke test tomorrow.
Maya (CSM): @Olivia please post the smoke test result here once done. If green, we use prod-like demo.
Olivia (Solutions): Will do.
Arjun (AM): For the renewal slide — we should be explicit: health = yellow (usage dip in week 6), risk = medium. Need proposed mitigations.
Maya (CSM): Agreed. Mitigations: 1) targeted enablement session, 2) dashboard access for execs, 3) pilot of cache tuning.
Samira (Enablement): I'll draft the invite copy and 30-min agenda. Want to include a short training video snippet.
Elliot (Eng): On cache tuning pilot — I can prepare a perf note and cost delta. Will need access to the customer's sampling window.
Maya (CSM): @Elliot I can share logs + sampling range by EOD.
Arjun (AM): Slide ownership so it's clear: Account health — Arjun; Renewals/asks — Maya; Enablement — Samira; Demo + tech notes — Elliot/Olivia.
Samira (Enablement): Noted. Also request: sales to approve invite list for the enablement session (execs + product leads).
Arjun (AM): I'll run the invite list by the AE and loop back.
Olivia (Solutions): Smoke test completed — demo env green. Posting link: https://redwood-demo.example.com/session/abc123 (note: auth popup shows for first-time users). :white_check_mark:
Maya (CSM): Great. Add that link to slide 5 and call out auth note.
Elliot (Eng): Sharing snippet for slide 6 (perf expectations):
```
- Baseline p95 latency: 220ms
- After cache tuning: p95 ~ 160ms (expected)
- Estimated cost change: +4% compute, -18% token cost
```
Arjun (AM): Thanks. Can you convert that to a single bullet for execs and attach a one-sentence takeaway?
Elliot (Eng): Yep — will add: "Cache tuning yields lower latency with minor compute increase; improves user experience and reduces token spend."
Samira (Enablement): Quick ask for design: can we get a one-slide 3-step customer enablement flow graphic? Need by Tue 2pm.
Olivia (Solutions): I can mock something simple and drop it in the deck.
Maya (CSM): Action items recap (Maya):
- Arjun: finalize health slide + renewal ask bullets (due Tue EOD)
- Samira: enablement slide + invite copy (due Tue 2pm)
- Elliot: perf note condensed for exec slide (due Tue noon)
- Olivia: finalize demo link + one-slide graphic (due Tue 2pm)
- Maya: consolidate and produce final PDF for execs (due Tue 6pm)
Arjun (AM): Adding a risk owner tag to renewal line: "AE (Sam) — monitoring usage patterns weekly".
Maya (CSM): @deploy-bot will we get the slide-deck upload event when someone pushes to the shared drive?
deploy-bot: new-file /shared/board-readout/leadership-brief-v1.pptx uploaded by Arjun at 1777777800
Samira (Enablement): I see the deck, starting edits now.
Olivia (Solutions): I added the mock flow to slide 9.
Elliot (Eng): Condensed perf bullet sent to slide 6.
Arjun (AM): Updated the renewal ask to include a short pilot incentive (3 months free monitoring). Please review.
Maya (CSM): Reviewing now. We should also capture feedback from the customer enablement session in a shared doc — Samira can you create a post-session feedback form?
Samira (Enablement): On it. I'll use our standard template and share link here.
Samira (Enablement): Feedback form: https://forms.example.com/f/enablement-cust-xyz
Maya (CSM): Final: let's run a 15-min dry run Tue 4pm PT. Please RSVP.
Arjun (AM): RSVP'd.
Olivia (Solutions): RSVP'd.
Elliot (Eng): RSVP'd.
Samira (Enablement): RSVP'd.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone — we're on track. If any blockers pop up ping me directly. :rocket:
